title: Ndzingo Ehansi Ka Magandlati
intro: Muprofeta un’wana, loyi a tikisiweke hi vurhumiwa bya yena, u endle xiboho lexi n’wi yiseke ekule ni vanhu va yena ivi a nghena eka ndzingo lowu a nga wu langutelanga. Riendzo ra yena ri teke ku hundzuka lokukulu, ri ringa ripfumelo ra yena ni ku lehisa mbilu hi ndlela leyi dzikeke swinene. Xana u nga kuma vuxokoxoko bya xiendlakalo lexi lexi nga tolovelekangiki eka swikombiso leswi nyikeriweke?
clues: Muprofeta u rhumeriwe eka vanhu vo karhi, kambe u sukile hi ku hatlisa, a titwa a hlundzukile hi ku ala ka vona.
Riendzo ra yena ri n’wi yise elwandle, laha a khandziyeke xikepe lexi rhwaleke ndzhwalo wo tala a lava ku hundza.
Ku pfuke xidzedze lexikulu, xi xungeta xikepe, naswona ku endliwe xiboho xo lahlela munhu un’we elwandle leswaku ku oloviwa ndzhwalo, lexi kunguhatiweke hi vuhlolotwana.
U mitiwe hi xivumbiwa xa le ndzeni, xiendlakalo xa singita lexi vekiweke hi ku navela ka Xikwembu.
Endzeni ka swipimelo swa khwiri ra xivumbiwa, u huwelerile eka Hosi ya yena, a hundzuka ni ku dzunisa Allah emunyameni.

Endzhaku ka nkarhi wo karhi wa xikombelo lexikulu, u lahleriwe eribuweni leri nga riki na nchumu, a tsanile kambe a ha hanya, naswona endzhakunyana u vuyile a kuma leswaku vanhu va yena va hetelele va pfumerile.

outcome.answer: Ku tlhelela eka vanhu va yena lava hi nkarhi wolowo va pfumeleke

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
